messages.author: 9d7c257e609d0807
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] Can't open my R script file although when I load the function in the script it works
parts:
Scripts are not r objects. They are just text files. R doesnt handle them at all. Therefore to save a script you need tosave it yourself. Saving an r ovject just saves its internal representation. It doesnt save the commands that created it. In rstudio there is a notion of a project under which all scripts objects variables graphs etc handled together
Presumably when you save a project it saves everuthing including scripts
